description: VAPID configuration for Web Push, bound from the "WebPush" configuration section. When PublicKey/PrivateKey are empty a host may generate an ephemeral key pair at startup.

members.name: Subject
members.description: VAPID subject (a mailto: or origin URL).

members.name: PublicKey
members.description: VAPID public key (base64url, uncompressed P-256 point).

members.name: IsConfigured
members.description: True when a usable VAPID key pair is configured.
